component.name: GameGlass Hub
component.summary: Turn your phone or tablet into game controls

description.p: GameGlass Hub is the desktop companion for GameGlass. It pairs your phone or tablet with your PC and turns it into a second screen of touch controls for the games you play, so keybinds you would otherwise hunt for on the keyboard become buttons, dials and switches under your thumb.

ul.li: Connect a phone or tablet to your PC over your local network and use it as a live control surface
Browse and install ready-made control sets, called Shards, for supported games
Build your own controls with Forge, a visual no-code editor
Manage your GameGlass library and keep installed Shards up to date
Send keystrokes, macros and virtual gamepad input to any game running on the PC

description.p: A free GameGlass account is required. Some Shards are free and others are sold individually or through a subscription; pricing is shown in the app before purchase.

One-time setup: sending input to your games needs write access to /dev/uinput, which is granted by a udev rule on the host. A Flatpak cannot install that itself. If you already have Steam installed you almost certainly have it already; otherwise the Hub will tell you when input is unavailable, and the rule it needs is shipped inside this Flatpak at share/gg.gameglass.hub/udev/60-gameglass-input.rules along with instructions for copying it to /etc/udev/rules.d.
